answer: The protocol requires 1,000 unique credential nullifiers to authorize each autonomous agent, ensuring that no repair work is duplicated across the network. An honest agent pays 1,000 units for registration, while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000,000 units to bypass the gate. Our verifier scans the metadata pigment of every data shard, checking for the spiral signature of non-replayable repair proofs. We enforce strict identity isolation as if each agent resided on a remote, isolated island. Any attempt to reuse output triggers a permanent lockout without refund.
